title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Expedition Route Plan. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Expedition Route Plan
options.lineage: mountaineering expedition planning — topo maps, route cards, field journals
options.thesis: Every project is an expedition: a route of legs from base camp to summit, with the day's camp always marked and the weather of your calendar deciding how far you get.
options.viewport: A working shell: left rail (Dump, Expeditions, Route Profile, Briefs), main area listing projects as expedition cards each showing summit ETA and next leg; a route-profile strip runs beneath — the signature move — drawing this week's scheduled legs as a route with duration-true segment lengths and camp markers per day.
options.risk: Expedition ephemera can pile into theme (carabiners, flags); the build keeps only contour grammar, terrain palette, and journal type — layout stays a standard product shell.

raised.raise: Two-tone discipline: no muddy greys anywhere — terrain colors sit flat and unmodulated, state colors pure.
The next leg is always computed before you look — the morning brief renders first, one glance above the fold.
Duration is geometry: in the route profile a leg's drawn length is its estimated hours, to scale — no decorative segments.
Flat unmodulated state color, and motion that overshoots 0.4s and settles, expedition pacing not SaaS snappiness.
The weekly retro aligns this week against last on one shared baseline, plates on one stem.

options.label: Flight Planning
options.lineage: pilot flight bag — navigation charts, dispatch releases, NOTAMs
options.thesis: Every plan is a dispatch release: the route, the fuel (your hours), and the NOTAMs — assumptions you must read before departure.
options.viewport: Same product shell in chart grammar; the assumption panel reads as a NOTAM strip across the top of a plan — the strongest possible mapping for this product's mechanism.
options.risk: The most familiar planning metaphor in the list; the honest risk is it stays an aviation costume instead of a working tool.

options.label: Factory Catalog (FAC)
options.lineage: Factory Records catalog sleeves — matte black, fac numbers, coded color strips
options.thesis: Todos as catalog entries: assigned numbers, state in coded color, one item decoded to full color at a time.
options.viewport: Matte-black tool with white hairline schedule plot; projects indexed by number, decoded on selection.
options.case: Holds audience identification — a builder would wear this identity — but state-in-code and number-only navigation fight daily scanability; loses product clarity narrowly.
options.risk: Reads as music-museum retro when the coding is not ruthlessly consistent.

options.label: Data-Sublime Field
options.lineage: Ikeda-style datamatics — barcode columns, sine lattices, pure black and white
options.case: Fuses to art installation, not a working todo tool; scanability dies at data density.
options.kept: Total two-tone palette commitment — raised into the assigned direction.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.case: One item owning the viewport destroys this product's core value: seeing all projects and their ETAs at once.
options.kept: The next item always loaded and one snap away — raised as always-computed morning brief.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.lineage: dance notation — shaped blocks whose length is exact duration
options.case: Duration-as-length is genuinely legible, but the bilateral limb columns map to nothing in the product.
options.kept: Exact-duration-as-geometry — raised as scale-true leg lengths in the route profile.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.case: Lobe navigation is charming leisure cartography; a daily task tool needs lists and tables it can scan.
options.kept: Flat unmodulated color and 0.4s overshoot motion — raised into the assigned direction.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.lineage: plates of one plant on a shared baseline, stage by stage
options.case: Fixed-scale comparison is beautiful for retrospectives but the folio sequence maps poorly to daily operation.
options.kept: The shared-baseline registered comparison — raised as the weekly retro view.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Linear/Notion-grade clean SaaS productivity UI: sidebar, cards, neutral palette, one accent — executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects from a todo app, at impeccable fidelity.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design — the rut this round exists to refuse.
